items.title: Gather your documents
items.body: Keep your passport, entry permit or visa papers, employment or study letters, and certified copies of degrees and marriage or birth certificates together. Scan copies to a safe place.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Plan your first month of money
items.body: Arrange a way to pay before you have a local bank account, such as a card that works abroad. Rents are often asked for in advance, so check your budget with your employer or sponsor.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Get a local phone number
items.body: Most other steps ask for a UAE mobile number. Compare the providers in the First 48 hours checklist.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Learn how to get around
items.body: Try a short trip on public transport or a ride-hailing app so you know how to reach work, school or the clinic.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Know where to go for health care
items.body: Find the nearest clinic and pharmacy that accept your insurance, and save the address before you need it.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Follow your residency and Emirates ID steps
items.body: Your employer, sponsor or university usually guides the medical test, biometrics and Emirates ID. Keep every receipt and reference number. Always confirm steps in the official app or website.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Open a bank account
items.body: Banks usually ask for your Emirates ID or residency papers and a salary or employment letter. Ask your employer which banks they work with.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Set up your home
items.body: Once you have a tenancy contract, set up electricity and water with the provider for your emirate, and internet with a telecom provider.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Start school applications early
items.body: Popular schools can have waiting lists. Shortlist schools near home and check them with the official school regulator for your emirate.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Find your people
items.body: Join a community group, a faith community or a sports club, and say hello to a local guide on NEXTORA.
items.source: PLACEHOLDER: AI-written draft, awaiting human review

items.title: Check your paperwork
items.body: Make sure your residency, Emirates ID, tenancy and insurance details all match, and note their renewal dates.
